comments.text:
Name: Tadplode 
Appearance: Resembling a tadpole, this volatile fauna has small dragonfly like wings either side of it's main body. It's underbelly contains a luminescent explosive compound that it can either shoot at the player with or suicide dive at the player when it's health reaches 0. If you hit the explosive underbelly with a strong enough attack, it ruptures, killing the Tadplode and dealing explosive damage to whatever is around it. Uses it's barbed tail to attack up close. 
Behaviour: Annoying little devil that is agile, but very weak.
comments.author: @TheAverageBee
